headlines.text: Looking back to 2023, when the NJPW World TV Title made its debut as Zack Sabre Jr. vs. Action Andretti battled for the honor of being first champion, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.50 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle. Sabre showed off his trademark grappling, countering a springboard attempt into a Rings of Saturn to make Andretti tap and retain the NJPW World Television Championship.

Looking back to 2023, when history was made as Willow Nightingale vs. Emi Sakura contested the very first NJPW STRONG Women's Title match, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.15 ? a solid showing. Nightingale survived a hard-fought challenge from Emi Sakura, a wrestler she considers a mentor figure in the sport, eventually landing a sit-out powerbomb to retain her NJPW Strong Women's Championship.
That Friday in 2023, the ROH Pure Title was up for grabs as Katsuyori Shibata vs. Lee Moriarty went to war, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.08 ? a well-worked match. A hard-fought battle for the gold.
